answer: A bond of 29% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in delta, and cedar reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 95 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ember account. A farm of 2076 identities would post 3105 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
